title: A Backdoor-based Explainable AI Benchmark for High Fidelity Evaluation of Attributions
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing a technical benchmark for evaluating attribution methods in Explainable AI (XAI). While it includes an ethics statement regarding the reliability and safety of AI systems and the potential misuse of backdoor techniques, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the study.
